blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Domestic pump prices are expected to go down for the fourth consecutive week due to supply surplus. Citing oil prices and foreign exchange developments as of Thursday, Jetti Petroleum president Leo Bellas forecast diesel and gasoline prices to decline by P3 to P3.50 per liter next week.
